[EN] My father was a soldier, my mother was a soldier, their parents were soldiers. When I get home, I've got a legacy to uphold. Hope nothing freezes off before then....
[ES] Mi padre era soldado, mi madre era soldada, sus padres eran soldados. Cuando vuelva a casa, tengo un legado que honrar. Espero que no se me congele nada antes de eso...
